title: Convert a genuine weak Stein witness into a paid terminal law bound
statement: If actual X of mean mu and a valid L2 latent witness D satisfy E[(X-mu) dot grad f(X)-a^2Delta f(X)]=E[D:Hess f(X)] for all admissible scalar tests,then a fresh independent nu-Gaussian reserve gives full TV<=||D||_(L2,HS)/(2sqrt(2)nu^2) from N(mu,(a^2+nu^2)I). With e=||D||/(a^2sqrt(d)),fixed relative reserve yields O(sqrt(d)e).

A generic polylog factor multiplied at every depth can be quasipolylog and is insufficient
Reserves,coefficient fitting,precision and scalar work remain inside the total budget
